description: 对已冻结失败作信号/费用/未运行账户边界解释，不重训、不改信号、不运行账户；执行前保存。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save_new(name,o):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已存在，不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
paths=[R+'/result.json',R+'/每日采购条件评分.csv',R+'/两模型全部自然高分机会.csv','reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet','data/reference/510300_dividends.csv','reports/research/510300_export_score_target_gap_diagnostic_v1/全部32原机会_费用与入场年归属.csv']
parents=[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p)} for p in paths]
save_new('固定失败归因协议.json',{'registered_at':now(),'parents':parents,'scope':'只解释E36既有主期485评分/8自然机会的信号、费用及未运行账户边界。','calculation':'保留全部原机会端点和登记日权益，原端点零费用算术界与原净标签逐笔配对；不是新标签或可执行账户。','preserved':'不改评分阈值/预测符号/模型/成员/时期/持有/风险限制，不移除失败事件。','new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0})
result=json.loads((OUT/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert result['status']=='REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_PURCHASE_QUANTITY_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT'
d=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/paths[3]);div=pd.read_csv(ROOT/paths[4]);div['record_date']=pd.to_datetime(div.record_date)
events=pd.read_csv(OUT/'两模型全部自然高分机会.csv')
main=events[(events['model']=='采购十变量')&(events.era=='2024—2025')].copy()
assert len(main)==8
prior=pd.read_csv(ROOT/paths[5]).set_index('idx');rows=[];matched=0
for r in main.itertuples(index=False):
 a=int(r.entry_idx);b=int(r.exit_idx);entry=pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[a]);exit=pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[b])
 assert str(entry.date())==r.entry_date and str(exit.date())==r.exit_date
 rights=div[(div.record_date>=entry)&(div.record_date<exit)].cash_dividend_per_share.sum()
 gross=(float(d.open.iloc[b])+float(rights))/float(d.open.iloc[a])-1
 net=float(r.net_event_return)
 assert np.isclose(net,float(d.net_label.iloc[int(r.idx)]),rtol=0,atol=1e-10)
 assert gross>=net-1e-10
 if r.idx in prior.index:
  assert np.isclose(gross,float(prior.loc[r.idx,'fixed_endpoints_raw_zero_cost_return']),rtol=0,atol=1e-10)
  matched+=1
 rows.append({'idx':int(r.idx),'signal_date':r.signal_date,'entry_date':r.entry_date,'exit_date':r.exit_date,'entry_year':entry.year,'raw_entry_open':float(d.open.iloc[a]),'raw_exit_open':float(d.open.iloc[b]),'entitled_dividend_per_share':float(rights),'saved_net5':net,'fixed_endpoints_raw_zero_cost_return':gross,'total_fee_quote_drag_difference':gross-net,'actual_added_path':bool(r.actual_added_path),'is_explanatory_bound_not_account':True})
cost=pd.DataFrame(rows);cost.to_csv(OUT/'全部8主期机会_原端点费用解释界.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
score=pd.read_csv(OUT/'每日采购条件评分.csv');block=score[score.era=='2024—2025'].copy()
assert len(block)==485
predchange=(block.nonlinear_prediction-block.control_nonlinear_prediction).abs()>1e-12
scorechange=(block.score-block.control_score).abs()>1e-12
oldmain=events[(events['model']=='原纠错八变量')&(events.era=='2024—2025')]
lost=oldmain[~oldmain.signal_date.isin(main.signal_date)]
removed=[]
for r in lost.itertuples(index=False):
 x=block.loc[block.idx==r.idx].iloc[0]
 removed.append({'signal_date':r.signal_date,'original_score':float(x.control_score),'candidate_score':float(x.score),'original_prediction':float(x.control_nonlinear_prediction),'candidate_prediction':float(x.nonlinear_prediction),'actual_added_path':bool(x.added_field_on_actual_path),'saved_net5':float(x.actual_net5),'candidate_original_80_and_positive_eligibility':bool(x.score>=80 and x.nonlinear_prediction>0),'current_actual_path_features':x.actual_path_features})
summary={
'checked_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_FIXED_REJECTION_SIGNAL_COST_ACCOUNT_BOUNDARY_DIAGNOSIS',
'signal':{'primary_days':485,'tree_mse_change_vs_corrected8_fraction':result['primary_tree_mse_change_vs_control_fraction'],'gates':result['fixed_primary_gates'],'primary_natural_opportunities':8,'primary_pred_changed_days':int(predchange.sum()),'primary_score_changed_days':int(scorechange.sum()),'same_prediction_changed_score_days':int((~predchange&scorechange).sum()),'primary_actual_added_path_days':int(block.added_field_on_actual_path.sum()),'removed_original_natural_dates':removed,'new_original_natural_dates':result['primary_new_natural_high_score_dates']},
'costs':{'all_opportunities_retained':8,'net_mean':float(cost.saved_net5.mean()),'raw_endpoints_zero_cost_bound_mean':float(cost.fixed_endpoints_raw_zero_cost_return.mean()),'mean_arithmetic_fee_quote_drag_difference':float(cost.total_fee_quote_drag_difference.mean()),'gross_bound_remains_negative':bool(cost.fixed_endpoints_raw_zero_cost_return.mean()<0),'existing_e27_cost_rows_crosschecked':matched,'one_new_endpoint_arithmetic_row_not_new_model_label':8-matched,'no_executable_zero_cost_strategy':True},
'account':{'full_accounts_run':0,'risk_weight_or_cap_effect':'NOT_COMPUTED','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','natural_entry_year_counts':{str(k):int(v) for k,v in cost.groupby('entry_year').size().items()},'counts_are_signal_opportunities_not_full_account_cycles':True,'changing_account_constraints_does_not_pass_failed_prediction_admission':True},
'conclusion':'本固定候选的信号准入本身失败；原端点费用全去除的机会算术均值仍负，费用不是唯一原因。完整账户约束影响未计算，不据此编造账户夏普或通过放仓/改成本营救。',
'new_source_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
'old_result_unchanged':True,'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET'}
save_new('固定失败归因_信号费用与账户边界.json',summary)
for p in parents:assert sha(ROOT/p['path'])==p['sha256']
report=['# E36固定失败归因：信号、费用与账户边界','',
'原固定五项门只通过实际路径使用新增字段，主期树误差比纠错八变量增加'+f"{result['primary_tree_mse_change_vs_control_fraction']:.6%}"+'。新增业务信息参与了部分分割，但没有建立所需预测/机会增量。','',
'保留全部8原自然机会，费用后平均'+f"{summary['costs']['net_mean']:.6%}"+'；同端点原始开盘、原登记日分红、零佣金/零滑点算术界的均值'+f"{summary['costs']['raw_endpoints_zero_cost_bound_mean']:.6%}"+'。算术界仍负，不能把失败全部归于费用。该界不构成真实账户或获准的新策略。','',
'原固定自然机会按入场年为'+json.dumps(summary['account']['natural_entry_year_counts'],ensure_ascii=False)+'；这是信号机会，非已运行账户周期。完整账户、风险权重/仓位约束效果及净夏普未计算，不能由费用界或信号均值替代。','',
'主期预测改变'+str(summary['signal']['primary_pred_changed_days'])+'日、分数改变'+str(summary['signal']['primary_score_changed_days'])+'日，其中预测未变但排名分数改变'+str(summary['signal']['same_prediction_changed_score_days'])+'日。分数来自训练拟合分布；改变排名不等同于新增回报优势。全部被移出的旧自然日期及其原净标签已保存，没有据结果删事件或改80线。','',
'终态保持REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_PURCHASE_QUANTITY_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT。不反号、删列、改窗口/期限/时期、放仓或降费营救。历史首版未认证、采购动机及指数收益因果未识别；本比较不是独立验证。','',
'[全部8机会费用解释](全部8主期机会_原端点费用解释界.csv)、[归因结果](固定失败归因_信号费用与账户边界.json)、[原固定模型结果](result.json)。']
(OUT/'固定失败归因_信号费用与账户边界.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'平均净五日':summary['costs']['net_mean'],'同端点零费用算术界均值':summary['costs']['raw_endpoints_zero_cost_bound_mean'],'原自然机会入场年':summary['account']['natural_entry_year_counts'],'仅分数变但预测未变':summary['signal']['same_prediction_changed_score_days'],'原固定拒绝':'保持','新拟合':0,'新账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
